summary:
957
We have developed a video game centered on spacecraft launches, based on a "space mission design" challenge. In the game, players must select and assemble the correct components to ensure their spacecraft can carry out missions efficiently under specific constraints—such as limited resources and a realistic, progressively increasing level of difficulty—thereby fostering analytical and logical problem-solving skills. The game includes a "training" center that poses key questions; answering them correctly provides assistance for missions and earns experience points for leveling up, while also building knowledge of and interest in space exploration. Furthermore, the system provides continuous feedback regarding failures and potential improvements. The game is particularly significant because it uses an engaging, accessible format suitable for anyone—regardless of their prior knowledge of the subject—not only presenting information but also ensuring that players understand it and learn how it is applied in real-world scenarios.
details:
The central idea about our project, is that this game does not just let explore the space, but also makes education more interesting and atractive, providing each planet´s information for you to be able to survive, complete missions, pass levels, but most importantly, while learning.

Just like said before, it ´s principal benefit is encouraging you to expand your knowledge without feeling obligation, given that you will explore the space instead of memorizing words.

We want to make an impact on the society by providing new ways to learn this broad topic and show people that space is much more interesting than they think.

For the development of the project, we use some programs for coding, such as summer engine, cursor, codex and chatGPT. But we also used our computers and monitors.

The most creative part of our game is that you are able to design the satellite and the spacecraft. We also used our creativity while thinking what professions will the characters have, and what would be their habillities.

The main factors we considered in this project are: visual atraction, youth interest, educational purpose and futuristic horizon.
